// defect: A `globalTimeout` that ran out in the global teardown, after every test had run (measured). The measurement is whole, and the run is refused all the same: an error outside a test is not interpreted here — a worker's unhandled error between two tests costs the next one (`an-error-outside-any-test.json`), this one costs nothing, and telling the two apart would mean reading Playwright's wording for every phase it has. It is the stop sentence of a timeout with another phase in it, so a rule that takes any `Timed out waiting …s for the … to run` for an early stop takes this one too.

fake-docs-e2e.message: Timed out waiting 4s for the teardown for global teardown to run
